dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the lateral flank exhibit high-contrast, irregular perimeters with a sharp gradient from dark exterior boundaries to pale, high-intensity interiors. The primary dorsal-central ring has a crenulated outer edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, asymmetrical pixel clusters along the dorsal ridge. Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients interspersed between larger rings on the lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent lateral 'O' structures form an irregular scalene triangle. Connecting these with the centroids of the two primary dorsal annuli defines an elongated pentagonal spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, amorphous, high-intensity patch with soft, diffuse boundaries is visible on the ventral-lateral margin, distinct from the structured annuli.
